alerts.headline: Nifty IT jumps over 1% as TCS, Tech Mahindra, HCL Tech gain; Indian IT stocks buck global AI selloff
alerts.summary: Nifty IT jumped on Friday, with TCS, Tech Mahindra, HCL Tech and Infosys among the top Nifty gainers. Midcap IT stocks, including Persistent Systems and Coforge, also rallied, defying weakness in Indian benchmarks and a sharp global AI stoc
second_order_candidates: Winner: Indian IT services (TCS, TECHM, HCLTECH): when money leaves AI infrastructure and AI-capex names, defensive, cash-generating services companies with USD revenue and a weak-rupee tailwind attract rotation.

Losers: AI-infrastructure and neocloud names (NBIS, CoreWeave) whose valuations depend on continued capex growth; see the NBIS note below. Cause of the global AI selloff is not stated in the headline.
Catalyst: surprise - a rotation inside one session; no dated event. Could reverse if the AI selloff stops.

alerts.headline: IndiGo, Tata Motors PV among 10 Nifty stocks facing earnings downgrades
alerts.summary: Elara Securities identifies 10 Nifty 50 companies facing the sharpest earnings estimate downgrades for FY27 and FY28 against its Q2FY27 preview. IndiGo leads the list, followed by Tata Motors PV and Eternal. The companies span sectors inclu
second_order_candidates: Winner: none direct; analyst estimate cuts hit the named companies, so the relative winners are peers with intact estimates (for IndiGo: other listed carriers are not in our universe; for TMPV: Maruti and M&M, whose estimates are not on the downgrade list).

Losers: IndiGo (INDIGO) and Tata Motors PV (TMPV), because lower consensus EPS compresses the multiple; the same fall in expected cash flow also weighs on lessors and aircraft suppliers' sentiment only indirectly, not verified. Cause of each downgrade is in the slideshow, which this sandbox cannot open.
Catalyst: surprise - estimate revisions after Q2 results, no dated event ahead; the downgrades are probably already in the price.
Thesis fit: none (not drafted: a round-up of ten stocks, mechanism per stock unverified, near coin flip)
